items.name: Pest Haven
items.text:
The rotting hides and molding straw stuffing of skitterstitches are ideal nesting grounds for vermin and insect swarms. Any animal swarm sharing a space with a skitterstitch gains fast healing 3.

Additionally, if a creature deals at least 10 piercing or slashing damage to the skitterstitchstitch, the swarm can use its swarming bites Strike (or similar attack) against the attacker as a reaction.

Effect: Pest Haven

items.name: Spider Swarm Host
items.text: Skitterstitches host a Spider Swarm within themselves, which erupts out when the Skitterstitch is destroyed

items.name: Flay
items.text: The skitterstitch makes a blade Strike against an animal or humanoid. On a success, the skitterstitch slices a long strip of flesh from the target; if the skitterstitch dealt damage, it deals an additional 1d6 persistent bleed damage.

items.name: Skitterstitch Venom
items.text:
Saving Throw DC 23 Fortitude save

Maximum Duration 6 rounds

Stage 1 1d10 poison damage, Off-Guard, and Clumsy 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 1d10 poison damage, off-guard, and Clumsy 2 (1 round)

items.name: Stitch Skin
items.text:
Requirements The skitterstitch hasn't used this ability since the last time it successfully used its Flay ability

---

Effect The skitterstitch sews flayed flesh to its body to seal tears and rents. The skitterstitch regains 8 healing Hit Points.
